[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Jean Bryce was associated with Canongate, Edinburghshire, Scotland. Her birth year is uncertain: the 1841 household records Jean aged 55, consistent with an estimate around 1786.

== Research Notes ==
=== Possible Edinburgh death in 1848 ===

A derivative of the Edinburgh parish register records “Jane Bryce Or Glasgow”, aged 67, wife of John Glasgow, at Skinners Close, Edinburgh. Both the death and burial fields read 25 January 1848. The reference is OPR 685_3/35, item 3, page 27.<ref name="Jane1848">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBUR%2F1592752 Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Deaths &amp; Burials 1564–2017, Jane Bryce Or Glasgow], death and burial fields 25 January 1848, age 67, wife of John Glasgow, Skinners Close Edinburgh, OPR 685_3/35, item 3, page 27; derivative transcript inspected 4 November 2026, original uninspected.</ref> The transcript also has the literal occupation “Warhouse porter”; it does not make clear whether that describes Jane or her husband, so it is not assigned to her.

Jean Bryce and [[Glasgow-1460|John Glasgow]] are a compatible couple for this entry: their 1841 Canongate household names Jean, aged 55, and John, a shop porter. Jane/Jean, Bryce, the husband’s name and the Edinburgh porter context support the comparison. However, age 67 in January 1848 implies a birth between 26 January 1780 and 25 January 1781, differing from Jean’s uncertain circa-1786 estimate. No evidence yet bridges Hume’s Close to Skinners Close. The death and burial remain unassigned.

The paired Bryce/Glasgow surnames and wife clause concern a woman associated with a Glasgow husband; they do not establish Glasgow as her birth surname. The original entry should be checked for the two identical event dates, the occupation’s owner and the family identification.
